# Bill of Materials

The Clunkey Rover is planned as a four-wheel-drive autonomous rover. The following parts are planned for the physical build.

## Rover Parts

| Part | Quantity | Unit Price | Total | Purpose |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Hiwonder 4WD chassis kit (4 TT motors, 4 wheels, chassis, hardware) | 1 | $23.99 | $23.99 | Rover chassis, wheels, motors, and mounting hardware |
| ESP32 development board | 1 | $7.99 | $7.99 | Main microcontroller |
| TB6612FNG motor driver | 2 | $4.50 | $9.00 | Controls the four drive motors |
| HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor | 1 | $2.49 | $2.49 | Detects obstacles in front of the rover |
| 4×AA battery holder | 1 | $2.50 | $2.50 | Battery holder and power connection |
| AA batteries, 4-pack | 1 | $4.97 | $4.97 | Power source |
| Jumper wires | 1 set | $4.95 | $4.95 | Electrical connections |

**Rover parts subtotal: $55.89**
